expectations.query: SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES 'ma_ban_ghi', 'ma_chuong_trinh', 'ten_chuong_trinh', 'nam_hoc', 'hoc_ky', 'so_sinh_vien', 'tong_luot_hoc_phan', '_source_updated_at', '_record_checksum') AS required(column_name) WHERE column_name NOT IN (SELECT column_name FROM lakehouse.information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'silver' AND table_name = 'learning_outcomes')
SELECT CAST(count_if(ma_ban_ghi IS NULL OR ma_chuong_trinh IS NULL OR nam_hoc IS NULL OR hoc_ky IS NULL OR _source_updated_at IS NULL) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) FROM {data_asset_ref}
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM {data_asset_ref} GROUP BY ma_chuong_trinh, nam_hoc, hoc_ky HAVING count(*) > 1)
